topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: The walls that once held echoes of familiar steps now whisper of change, their surfaces stripped of the posters and paint that told stories of years. The hallway, once a silent companion, now hums with the scrape of furniture and the murmur of deals. My room, my sanctuary, feels smaller, the air thicker with the unspoken. Familiar faces grow distant, their visits less frequent, their smiles replaced by the cautious glances of strangers. The comforting routine of morning commutes and evening returns unravels, threads coming loose, the fabric of this place slowly fraying. Outside, the world continues, indifferent, but here, the ground shifts beneath my feet.
